'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
****Thousands of fighting-age men continue to leave [[Russia]] due to the [[mobilization]]. Massive lines are reported at the country's [[Georgia–Russia border|borders with]] [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] [[Finland–Russia border|and]] [[Finland]]. [https://inews.co.uk/news/world/border-queues-up-twenty-six-hours-build-russians-flee-avoid-ukraine-war-draft-1876877 (iNews)] 
***[[2022 anti-war protests in Russia]]
****At least 700 people are detained during [[anti-war movement|anti-war]] protests across Russia. [https://www.itv.com/news/2022-09-24/russia-arrests-more-than-700-people-as-protests-continue-against-putins-order (ITV News)]
*[[Kurdish separatism in Iran]]
**The [[Iranian Revolutionary Guards]] [[shell (projectile)|shell]] the "[h]eadquarters of anti-Iranian terrorists" in [[Iraqi Kurdistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-guards-launch-artillery-attack-militants-iraqi-kurdistan-2022-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*Fifteen people are killed and many others are injured after armed bandits attacked a mosque in [[Zamfara]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/armed-bandits-kill-15-mosque-northwest-nigeria-residents-2022-09-24/ (Reuters)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Fiona]] leaves more than 500,000 people [[power outage|without power]] in [[Atlantic Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/nova-scotia/fiona-has-arrived-in-atlantic-canada-time-to-stay-inside-1.6594245 (CBC)]
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Two people are killed and 120,000 people experience a power outage after [[Tropical Storm Talas (2022)|Tropical Storm Talas]] hits [[central Japan]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/japan-typhoon-tala-2-dead-rcna49269 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Ukraine]] announces a reduction of [[Iran]]ian [[diplomatic mission]] staff in response to the delivery of [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] to [[Russia]] as part of the [[Russo-Ukrainian War]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-it-downed-four-iranian-drones-zelenskiy-raps-tehran-2022-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The death toll from the protests in [[Iran]] increases to 50. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/50-killed-in-iran-protest-crackdown-says-ngo-thousands-join-pro-hijab-rallies-101663952249535.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
**The [[Iranian Army]] announces that it will "confront the enemies" in response to the ongoing protests. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1711562 (Dawn)]
** Reports emerge that protestors have allegedly "taken control" of the city of [[Oshnavieh]] after security forces withdraw. [https://atalayar.com/en/content/iranian-government-denies-losing-control-face-anti-veil-protests (Atalayar)]
*Three people are injured after a shooting occurred at an amusement park in [[West Mifflin]], [[Allegheny County]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pittsburgh-pennsylvania-eaf186199eaa4924f3d13cdc6b95adbe (AP)] [https://en.wikinews.org/wiki/Shooting_injures_three_at_Kennywood_amusement_park_in_Pennsylvania,_US (Wikinews)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Nauruan parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[Nauru]] head to the polls to elect members of [[Parliament of Nauru|parliament]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/475357/nauruans-vote-for-a-new-parliament (RNZ)]
*[[2022 Angolan general election]]
**Thousands of people protest in [[Luanda]], [[Angola]], accusing incumbent president [[João Lourenço]] of [[electoral fraud]] in the latest election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/thousands-angolas-capital-protest-alleged-electoral-fraud-2022-09-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**[[Elon Musk]] says that [[Starlink]] will be enabled inside [[Iran]]ian cities after the [[United States]] [[United States Department of State|State]] and [[United States Department of the Treasury|Treasury Departments]] announce measures to increase internet freedom and access to information in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/musk-says-activating-starlink-response-blinken-internet-freedom-iran-2022-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*The planned launch of [[Artemis 1]] is newly delayed due to a storm. [https://www.bbc.com/news/63022093.amp (BBC News)]
